prompt: Implement an immutable 2D vector as a record: plus, scaled, dot, and a static zero() factory, each returning new values instead of mutating. Complete the Vec2 record.
explanation: Record components are final, so 'changing' a vector really means building a new one -- each operation passes fresh component values to the canonical constructor. Inside the record body the components are plain fields (x, other.x), and the generated equals() compares them component-wise, which is why the tests can compare whole Vec2 values. zero() is a static factory: it belongs to the type, not to any instance, and gives a readable name to a common value.
hints: Every operation ends with new Vec2(...): records have no setters to call.
Inside the record you can read this.x as just x, and another vector's component as other.x.
zero() is static -- call it as Vec2.zero() -- and simply returns new Vec2(0.0, 0.0).
